positions.title: Programmer
positions.description:
Lead continued development maintance and deploy Time and Attandance and production tracking software

•	Use C# and Visual Basic.net to make application changes to Web services, Windows services and winform applications
•	Write SQL/Transact SQL scripts to make to troubleshoot and diagnose questions clients have.
•	Listen and interprate customers needs to setup the system to work as they need it to and it pays correctly
•	Create custom imports and exports from our system for new and existing clients based on customer specifications. 
•	Write and learn other dialects of SQL for other database systems we need to integrate with
•	Create and Update database tables, indexes. Views and Stored procedures 
•	Create and maintain custom SSRS and Crystal reports for clients

positions.title: Reporting Analyst
positions.description:
Design, create and analyze informational and decision support reports that help the state more quickly determine the effectiveness and quality of Medicaid’s mental health care. 

•	Elicit and translate customer requirements into programmable specifications and evaluate for ad hoc and routine reporting, consistently meeting deadlines.
•	Design and automate custom reports using Crystal Reports and Business Objects to enhance productivity – e.g., automated rate setting, which reduced number of people by 75 percent and time spent by 50 percent.
•	Create stored procedures and functions and use Transact-SQL and VB.net to create automation utilities that reduce processing time and add reporting flexibility.
•	Perform statistical data analysis to determine patterns and trends, which enables clients to make better business decisions.
•	Translate and present data results to clients in a way they can quickly assimilate, also regularly receiving positive feedback on quick turnaround.
•	Developed original interface that automated transfer of authorization data to state’s fiscal agent for billing, which previously required 10+ people to handle.
•	Architected billing system for long-term, supported employment program that enabled State of Maine to monitor authorized billing hours to effectively manage costs.

positions.title: Field Artillery Instructor
positions.description:
Trained and supervised students in cannon gunnery procedures/use and managed verification of safe firing data.

•	Conducted daily training sessions, including safe firing procedures, involving 20-25 students.
•	Reinforced training with live firing exercises, which significantly improved skills.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst
positions.description:
Designed new and configured existing time and attendance software for large healthcare facilities, which improved productivity and data quality and reduced costs. 

•	Established and maintained clients’ payroll rules, payroll interfaces and employee downloads using Visual Basic and C#, all with different program requirements.
•	Wrote SQL/Transact SQL scripts to accommodate additional records, address client-specific changes, and troubleshoot databases more efficiently.
•	Analyzed and validated reported software issues, reported findings, and recommended and provided solutions, consistently resolving 100 percent of all known issues.
•	Created core software builds that integrated API products and downloads and managed software upgrades that addressed known bugs and expanded functionality.
